sources.snippet: This article proposed the problem of cyberbullying detection on social media and the challenges of applying machine learning and deep learning techniques to real-time datasets. Also stated main objective of developing a hybrid CNN-RF model that can work on both small and large datasets with high accuracy and speed.

sources.snippet: Cyberbullying affects $20-40 \%$ of digitally connected adolescents, yet existing automated detection systems achieve highly variable accuracy and lack ethical decision-making mechanisms.
